results.raw: False. Zambia’s parliament has not enacted or published any Independent Broadcasting Authority Act (Act No. 25 of 2025).
False. The Securities (Advertisements) Rules are statutory instruments (S.I. 166/1993, amended 13/1994) issued by the Minister, not 2025 directives from the Zambia Securities and Exchange Commission.
False. The African War Memorial Fund Act, 1954 predates Zambia’s independence (1964) and could not have been published by the Zambia Legal Information Institute.
False. Zambia’s 2026 parliamentary session has not occurred, so no Act No. 9 of 2026 exists.
False. The Securities (Conduct of Business) Rules, S.I. No. 168 of 1993, were issued by Zambia’s Minister of Finance, not published by the ZSEC in 2025.
False. No official Zambian regulations titled 'Access to Information (General) Regulations, 2025' exist; the cited source is not authoritative.
False. The Independent Broadcasting Authority Act, 2025 (Act No. 25 of 2025) is Zambian legislation, not published by South Africa Open By-laws (Laws.Africa).
False. The cited instrument is a statutory instrument (S.I. No. 166 of 1993, amended by Act 13 of 1994), not a 2023 directive published by the Commission.
False. The African War Memorial Fund Act, 1954 is Zambian legislation, not a Namibian source, so NamLII cannot be its official publisher.
False. The Banking and Financial Services Act, 2026 (Act No. 9 of 2026) is Zambian legislation, not published by the Zimbabwe Legal Information Institute.
False. The Securities (Conduct of Business) Rules, S.I. No. 168 of 1993, were issued by Zambia’s Minister of Finance, not published by the Securities and Exchange Commission in 2022.
False. The Access to Information (General) Regulations, 2025 are Zambian, not Eswatini, and the Central Bank of Eswatini is not their publisher.
